name: Control by unit
description: One control’s evidence told by business unit: how many of each unit’s applications pass and fail it, the units under a floor, and the failing applications with the unit that answers for each. It has no file of its own: it reads the evidence feed and the owners mapped onto it, so it is used once for each control worth a closer look.

inputs.description: An evidence feed: an application a row, with the control’s status and the day a filled row came from
Each application with the business unit that answers for it

settings.name: floor
settings.description: The share of a unit’s applications that must pass, in percent: a unit under it is behind

properties.title: Applications
properties.description: How many of the unit’s applications the control was judged on: those that pass and those that fail

properties.title: Passing
properties.description: How many of them pass the control

properties.title: Failing
properties.description: How many of them fail it

properties.title: Pass share
properties.description: The share of them that pass

properties.title: Behind
properties.description: Whether the unit’s pass share is under the floor this use sets
